sources.name: Agency Consultation Letters
sources.publisher: Reviewer-supplied agency correspondence
sources.known_limitations: Agency consultation letters must be supplied, reviewed, and accepted by a human reviewer before use in exports.
sources.notes: Attachment C placeholder for the example deliverable.

sources.name: Hazardous Materials Support Report
sources.publisher: Reviewer-supplied or project consultant
sources.known_limitations: Hazardous materials support reports must be supplied, reviewed, and accepted by a human reviewer before use in exports.
sources.notes: Attachment B placeholder for the example deliverable.

sources.name: Census TIGER/Line and ACS
sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau
sources.known_limitations: Demographic context should not be treated as a final equity determination. ACS values require source-year, geography, and margin-of-error review before external use.
sources.notes: Community profile and socioeconomic context. Sprint 2.1 records Census setup and missing-key status only; table generation is deferred to Sprint 2.2.

sources.name: HIFLD / Community Infrastructure
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Homeland Security and partner agencies
sources.known_limitations: Availability and access conditions should be validated before repeatable use.
sources.notes: Hospitals, schools, fire stations, utilities, and other infrastructure context.

sources.name: Local Businesses and Economic Nodes
sources.publisher: Local governments, chambers of commerce, business directories, or reviewer-supplied sources
sources.known_limitations: Business and economic-node sources vary by jurisdiction and should not be treated as comprehensive without reviewer validation.
sources.notes: Manual/stubbed source for local businesses and economic nodes until a repeatable source is validated.

sources.name: MARIS Administrative and Physical Boundary Context
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System
sources.known_limitations: Boundary context is used for project location and report context only; source currency and official boundary use should be checked before final reporting.
sources.notes: Local Mississippi warehouse context for county names, state boundary, and coastline/reference boundary layers.

sources.name: MARIS Community Facilities and Places
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System and source agencies
sources.known_limitations: Community facility and place layers are screening context and may not reflect current facilities, emergency service coverage, or local planning determinations.
sources.notes: Local Mississippi warehouse context for communities, fire stations, and recreational facilities.

sources.name: MARIS Public Cultural and Tribal Context
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System and source agencies
sources.known_limitations: Public cultural layers do not include restricted archaeological records and do not replace qualified cultural resources review or agency consultation.
sources.notes: Local Mississippi warehouse context for public cemetery, National Register, and tribal land layers.

sources.name: MDAH Public Historic Resources Inventory
sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Archives and History
sources.known_limitations: Public historic context is separate from restricted archaeological records.
sources.notes: Public cultural/historic context only.

sources.name: MDAH Restricted Archaeological / HSMT Review
sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Archives and History
sources.known_limitations: Do not automate restricted access or expose sensitive locations without explicit approval.
sources.notes: Manual placeholder for qualified cultural resource review.

sources.name: National Flood Hazard Layer
sources.publisher: Federal Emergency Management Agency
sources.known_limitations: FEMA NFHL effective data is optional screening context. Not all effective FIRMs have GIS data available; official-purpose display should use map data that meets FEMA accuracy standards. Preliminary and pending flood hazard layers are outside this automated source in the current slice.
sources.notes: Optional effective floodplain/floodway context from Flood Hazard Zones layer 28.

sources.name: USGS NHD Flowlines Mississippi
sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / Mississippi Automated Resource Information System
sources.known_limitations: NHD may miss local ditches, altered drainage, or recent changes visible in imagery.
sources.notes: Specific seeded NHD flowline source; live downloader rollup remains usgs_nhd_hydrography.

sources.name: National Hydrography Dataset / The National Map Hydrography
sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey
sources.known_limitations: Hydrography may miss local ditches, altered drainage, or recent changes visible in imagery.
sources.notes: Primary first-pass stream, river, ditch, and crossing context source.

sources.name: USGS NHD Other Areas Mississippi
sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / Mississippi Automated Resource Information System
sources.known_limitations: NHD area features are screening context and require reviewer interpretation.
sources.notes: Specific seeded NHD other-area source; live downloader rollup remains usgs_nhd_hydrography.

sources.name: USGS NHD Waterbodies Mississippi
sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / Mississippi Automated Resource Information System
sources.known_limitations: NHD waterbody mapping may not reflect current conditions or jurisdictional status.
sources.notes: Specific seeded NHD waterbody source; live downloader rollup remains usgs_nhd_hydrography.

sources.name: MDEQ 2024 303(d) Impaired Waters and TMDL Complete Waters
sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality
sources.known_limitations: MDEQ 2024 303(d) and TMDL-complete layers are screening-level water-quality context. They do not independently establish watershed context and should be paired with HUC/NHD layers when hydrologic or watershed context is needed.
sources.notes: Seeded from the newest usable MDEQ REST service found for this pass. The service contains active 303(d) line/polygon layers and TMDL-complete line/polygon layers from the 2024 Active 303(d) list.

sources.name: USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset HUC-12 Subwatersheds Mississippi
sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / Natural Resources Conservation Service
sources.known_limitations: HUC-12 subwatershed polygons provide watershed/subwatershed screening context. They do not establish direct project impacts and require reviewer interpretation with NHD and water-quality source layers.
sources.notes: Manually downloaded Mississippi HUC-12 WBD shapefile bundle. Materialization selects subwatersheds intersecting project analysis bounds and preserves selected watershed polygons for context rendering.

sources.name: Google Earth Visual Review Context
sources.publisher: Google and imagery providers
sources.known_limitations: Do not automate paid API usage or treat visual observations as authoritative facts without approval and review.
sources.notes: Visual review context only.

sources.name: MARIS/NAIP 2025 Imagery
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System / USDA Farm Service Agency
sources.known_limitations: Local MARIS/NAIP 2025 county imagery is basemap and visual context only. Real MrSID .sid/.sdw payloads are not retained as active Review Assist assets and are unsupported for rendering; active figures use project-local renderable NAIP/aerial assets when available.
sources.notes: Indexed from sources/aerial_base_maps/maris_naip_2025 metadata/source manifests when present. Imagery observations are reviewer context, not authoritative findings.

sources.name: MARIS / State Orthophotos and GIS Context
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System
sources.known_limitations: Layer currency and metadata should be checked per dataset.
sources.notes: Statewide imagery, reference layers, and source discovery.

sources.name: NAIP Imagery
sources.publisher: USDA Farm Service Agency
sources.known_limitations: Imagery observations remain review items and require capture date/attribution tracking. Project-local NAIP materialization is bounded by AOI/tile/size limits and does not replace authoritative source layers.
sources.notes: Basemap, visual QC, and cropped imagery context. Review queue generation can create project-local renderable GeoTIFF assets from public NAIP COG assets when materialization is enabled.

sources.name: MARIS Conservation and Recreation Lands
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System and source agencies
sources.known_limitations: Public conservation, recreation, wildlife management, and easement boundaries are screening context and should be checked against current source-agency records before final use.
sources.notes: Local Mississippi warehouse context for parks, wildlife management areas, and easement areas.

sources.name: National Land Cover Database
sources.publisher: Multi-Resolution Land Characteristics Consortium
sources.known_limitations: NLCD is generalized land cover and should not replace site-specific field or imagery review.
sources.notes: Useful for developed, forested, impervious, and low-disturbance context.

sources.name: USDA NRCS Easements Mississippi
sources.publisher: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service / Mississippi Automated Resource Information System
sources.known_limitations: Easement boundaries are screening context and require source-agency confirmation before external reliance.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse conservation/public lands context.

sources.name: USFWS National Wildlife Refuges Mississippi
sources.publisher: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service / Mississippi Automated Resource Information System
sources.known_limitations: 1997 refuge boundaries are screening context and should be checked against current USFWS records.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse conservation/public lands context.

sources.name: County Parcels / Tax Assessor Property Age
sources.publisher: County or local government
sources.known_limitations: County schemas, freshness, licensing, and year-built fields vary widely.
sources.notes: Property age, ownership, parcel, access, and ROW screening context.

sources.name: EPA Envirofacts / ECHO Regulated Facilities
sources.publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
sources.known_limitations: ECHO facility records are screening-level regulatory context. Locations, program flags, compliance fields, and facility status require reviewer QC and do not replace environmental due diligence, hazardous materials review, field verification, or professional judgment.
sources.notes: Regulated facility and compliance context from the ECHO Facilities map service.

sources.name: EPA Facility Registry Service Facilities Mississippi
sources.publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and Mississippi Automated Resource Information System
sources.known_limitations: FRS facility locations and program associations are screening context and require reviewer QC before use in hazardous materials or regulatory context.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse source from MARIS EPA Facility Registry Service shapefile; EPA state_single_ms CSV is preserved as supplementary raw provenance.

sources.name: MARIS Brownfields
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System / EPA
sources.known_limitations: Brownfield status, cleanup status, and location accuracy require reviewer/source-agency confirmation.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse brownfield facility context.

sources.name: MARIS NPDES Facilities
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System / EPA
sources.known_limitations: NPDES facility records are screening context and do not replace permit/compliance review.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse NPDES facility context.

sources.name: MARIS Solid Waste Landfill Facilities
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System / MDEQ
sources.known_limitations: 2012 landfill facility records may be stale and require current MDEQ/reviewer confirmation.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse landfill facility context.

sources.name: MARIS Superfund Sites
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System / EPA
sources.known_limitations: Superfund context requires current EPA record review and does not replace environmental due diligence.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse Superfund facility context.

sources.name: MARIS Toxics Release Inventory Facilities
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System / EPA
sources.known_limitations: TRI reporting context requires reviewer QC and current EPA source review.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse TRI facility context.

sources.name: MARIS Underground Storage Tanks
sources.publisher: Mississippi Automated Resource Information System / MDEQ
sources.known_limitations: UST records may be stale and require current MDEQ/reviewer confirmation.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse UST facility context.

sources.name: MDEQ Environmental Context Layers (Manual Residual Context)
sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality
sources.known_limitations: Specific seeded regulated facility layers are cataloged separately where available. Remaining MDEQ interactive-map data may need manual export and validation before repeatable analysis.
sources.notes: Residual manual context for MDEQ layers not yet represented by specific seeded source IDs such as USTs, landfills, and related facility layers.

sources.name: Mississippi Oil and Gas Well Context
sources.publisher: Mississippi State Oil and Gas Board
sources.known_limitations: Oil and gas well context is screening-level and requires current Oil and Gas Board review and reviewer confirmation before use in report findings.
sources.notes: Seeded local warehouse source when available; otherwise manual/source-review context.

sources.name: SSURGO / Web Soil Survey
sources.publisher: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service
sources.known_limitations: Soil map units are screening-level context and may not represent exact field boundaries.
sources.notes: Hydric soils, prime farmland, and design-related soil context.

sources.name: Mississippi Natural Heritage Program Context
sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
sources.known_limitations: Sensitive rare species data may be restricted or request-based.
sources.notes: Placeholder for state species of concern and rare community review.

sources.name: USFWS Critical Habitat
sources.publisher: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
sources.known_limitations: Critical habitat GIS is screening context, not the legal boundary source, not a project species list, and not a replacement for IPaC or agency consultation.
sources.notes: GIS-checkable species/habitat context.

sources.name: IPaC Project Report
sources.publisher: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
sources.known_limitations: IPaC outputs are project/report based and should be attached as source material.
sources.notes: Represent as reviewer-attached document until workflow is defined.

sources.name: Airport and Aeronautical Facility Context
sources.publisher: Federal Aviation Administration or local aviation authorities
sources.known_limitations: Airport proximity context requires current FAA/local source review and does not establish aviation clearance or project approval.
sources.notes: Seeded from manually downloaded FAA airport/aeronautical facility point data. Missing or stale airport context remains a reviewer/source-gap item and should not be inferred from unrelated transportation or utility layers.

sources.name: Local Utility and Infrastructure Sources
sources.publisher: Local governments, utility providers, and authoritative infrastructure sources
sources.known_limitations: Public utility data may be incomplete or intentionally generalized.
sources.notes: Water, sewer, pipeline, energy, communications, and other utility context.

sources.name: MDEQ/MARIS Public Water Supply Wells November 2024
sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality Office of Land and Water Resources / MARIS
sources.known_limitations: Filtered from the November 2024 statewide MDEQ/MARIS water wells layer to Public Water Supply records. The source metadata says the data is a timestamp and should not be considered up-to-date or the most accurate. Public water supply well context requires reviewer/source-agency confirmation before external reporting.
sources.notes: Seeded from MARIS Hydrology/MS_WaterWells_Nov2024, which credits MDEQ Office of Land and Water Resources as the data source and MARIS as distributor.

sources.name: MDOT / Local Transportation Context
sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Transportation and local agencies
sources.known_limitations: Recent projects, ROW, and design plans may require reviewer-supplied files.
sources.notes: Roads, ROW, recent alignments, plans, and existing transportation corridors.

sources.name: National Wetlands Inventory
sources.publisher: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
sources.known_limitations: NWI is screening-level data and does not define jurisdictional wetland boundaries.
sources.notes: Primary first-pass wetland and mapped waterbody source.
